context: A senpai and a teen chat
purpose: Teach: 負わ/乗ら/みせる/欠い/破れ/つっ/貼ら/吐く

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 桜、研究、責任を負わずに動く時期、終わったぞ。
lines.en: Sakura — the time for moving forward without taking responsibility ends here.
lines.style: Firm and direct, like a mentor marking a threshold. Steady eye contact. No softening. Weight on the final word.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。電車に乗らないで、自転車通学、続けてます。
lines.en: Yes. I'm still biking to campus instead of taking the train.
lines.style: Straightforward and earnest. A small nod on the affirmation. No defensiveness — just stating what she's doing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 発表前、原稿、教授にみせるのが、大事だ。
lines.en: Before your presentation, it's important you show your draft to the professor.
lines.style: Practical, teaching-tone. Light emphasis on 'important' — not urgent, but necessary. Clear-eyed and measured.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。データ、欠いた箇所、補強しています。
lines.en: Yes. I'm reinforcing the parts where the data was incomplete.
lines.style: Quiet focus. Direct acknowledgment without elaboration. The tone of someone doing the work, not explaining it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: メモ用紙、破れた箇所、テープで修理。
lines.en: And you've patched up that memo pad with tape.
lines.style: Dry, almost amused observation. Slight lift at the end — gentle ribbing wrapped in care. He's noticed the small detail.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 本棚に、つっかい棒、置いてあります。
lines.en: I've got a support stick wedged behind the bookshelf.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact. A small, self-aware pause before saying it — she knows how this sounds. No apology, just acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 論文、要旨を、まだ貼らないで、修正後に。
lines.en: Don't post the paper's abstract yet — wait until after you've made your revisions.
lines.style: Final instruction, calm and clear. The tone of someone who has thought this through. Slight emphasis on the timing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 体調管理、急に吐く症状、避けたいです。
lines.en: I want to keep my health in check — I don't want sudden symptoms getting in the way.
lines.style: Quiet concern beneath the polite surface. She's saying something vulnerable in a careful way. Slight fadeout, like she's doing what she can and hoping it's enough.
